$comment: Who each character is, for image prompts. Keyed by characters.json id. tier A = full expression set, B = named, C = crowd type. Edit freely; re-run build-art-prompts.mjs.

rama.who: Prince Rama of Ayodhya, the hero, eldest son of King Dasharatha; noble, calm and gentle, a peerless archer

lakshmana.who: Prince Lakshmana, Rama's devoted younger brother and constant companion; fiery, loyal and alert

sita.who: Sita, princess of Mithila and Rama's wife; graceful, gentle and steadfast

bharata.who: Prince Bharata, Rama's brother, son of Kaikeyi; righteous and sorrowful, rules Ayodhya in Rama's name

shatrughna.who: Prince Shatrughna, youngest brother, Bharata's companion; quiet and loyal

dasharatha.who: King Dasharatha of Ayodhya, Rama's aged father; a great king broken by a promise

kaushalya.who: Queen Kaushalya, Rama's mother, senior queen of Ayodhya; dignified and tender

kaikeyi.who: Queen Kaikeyi, Dasharatha's favourite queen, Bharata's mother; proud, strong-willed and beautiful

sumitra.who: Queen Sumitra, mother of Lakshmana and Shatrughna; wise and calm

manthara.who: Manthara, Kaikeyi's old hunchbacked maid; scheming and whispering

vishvamitra.who: The sage Vishvamitra, a former king turned great ascetic; stern, formidable and wise, Rama's teacher in arms

vasishtha.who: The sage Vasishtha, royal priest of Ayodhya; serene and venerable

janaka.who: King Janaka of Mithila, Sita's father; a philosopher-king, gentle and wise

ahalya.who: Ahalya, wife of the sage Gautama, freed from her curse by Rama; luminous and humble

guha.who: Guha, chief of the boatmen and forest people at the Ganga, Rama's friend; strong and warm-hearted

shabari.who: Shabari, an aged forest woman ascetic who waited her whole life to see Rama; humble and joyful

jatayu.who: Jatayu, the aged king of vultures, friend of Dasharatha, who fights Ravana to save Sita; a huge noble bird

hanuman.who: Hanuman, the mighty vanara, son of the wind, Rama's greatest devotee; strong, humble and fearless

sugriva.who: Sugriva, king of the vanaras in exile, Vali's younger brother, Rama's ally

vali.who: Vali, the mighty vanara king of Kishkindha, Sugriva's elder brother; powerful and proud

angada.who: Prince Angada, Vali's young son, envoy to Ravana's court; brave and spirited

jambavan.who: Jambavan, the ancient wise king of the bears, counsellor to the vanara army

nala.who: Nala, the vanara engineer who builds the bridge to Lanka

ravana.who: Ravana, the ten-headed king of Lanka; magnificent, proud and terrible, a great scholar and devotee of Shiva

mandodari.who: Queen Mandodari, Ravana's chief queen; wise, beautiful and sorrowful

kumbhakarna.who: Kumbhakarna, Ravana's colossal brother who sleeps for months; enormous, drowsy and fearsome when woken

indrajit.who: Indrajit, Ravana's son, conqueror of Indra, master of illusion; a proud young warrior

vibhishana.who: Vibhishana, Ravana's righteous younger brother who joins Rama; gentle and principled, a rakshasa of good heart

shurpanakha.who: Shurpanakha, Ravana's sister, whose desire and humiliation start the war; fierce rakshasi

maricha.who: Maricha, the rakshasa who becomes the golden deer; shifty and fearful of Rama

subahu.who: Subahu, a rakshasa who attacks Vishvamitra's sacrifice; violent and brutish

tataka.who: Tataka, a cursed giant demoness who turned a fertile land into a wasteland; Rama's first battle

viradha.who: Viradha, a huge rakshasa of the Dandaka forest who seizes Sita

khara.who: Khara, Ravana's brother who rules Janasthana with an army of fourteen thousand; a chariot warrior

malyavan.who: Malyavan, Ravana's aged maternal grandfather and counsellor; grey and cautious

trijata.who: Trijata, an old rakshasi guard in the Ashoka grove who comforts Sita; kind behind a fierce face

urmila.who: Urmila, Sita's sister and Lakshmana's wife; gentle and patient

mandavi.who: Mandavi, Sita's cousin and Bharata's wife

shrutakirti.who: Shrutakirti, Sita's cousin and Shatrughna's wife

parashurama.who: Parashurama, the fierce warrior-sage with the axe, who challenges Rama after the wedding

sumantra.who: Sumantra, Dasharatha's faithful charioteer and minister

atri.who: The sage Atri, aged forest hermit who welcomes Rama

anasuya.who: Anasuya, Atri's wife, a revered aged ascetic who blesses Sita

youngAscetic.who: Shravana, the young ascetic accidentally killed by young Dasharatha while fetching water for his blind parents

blindFather.who: Shravana's blind aged father, who curses Dasharatha in grief

gautama.who: The sage Gautama, Ahalya's husband; stern ascetic

sharabhanga.who: The sage Sharabhanga, an aged hermit of the Dandaka forest

agastya.who: The great sage Agastya, short and powerful, who gives Rama divine weapons

dushana.who: Dushana, Khara's general in Janasthana; a rakshasa warrior

trishiras.who: Trishiras, the three-headed rakshasa general of Janasthana

akampana.who: Akampana, the rakshasa who escapes Janasthana to warn Ravana

kabandha.who: Kabandha, a cursed headless giant with his face in his belly and immensely long arms

tara.who: Tara, Vali's wise queen, Angada's mother

sampati.who: Sampati, Jatayu's elder brother, an old vulture whose wings were burnt by the sun

svayamprabha.who: Svayamprabha, a radiant ascetic woman living in an enchanted cave

surasa.who: Surasa, mother of serpents, who tests Hanuman over the ocean; huge serpent-woman

simhika.who: Simhika, a sea demoness who catches Hanuman by his shadow

lankini.who: Lankini, the guardian demoness of Lanka's gate

aksha.who: Prince Aksha, Ravana's youngest son, who fights Hanuman; a bold boy warrior

garuda.who: Garuda, the divine eagle, Vishnu's mount, who frees Rama and Lakshmana from the serpent arrows; radiant and golden

sushena.who: Sushena, the vanara physician who names the healing herbs

matali.who: Matali, charioteer of Indra, who brings the divine chariot to Rama

ocean.who: Samudra, the god of the ocean, who rises from the waves to counsel Rama; majestic and watery

vanara.who: a vanara soldier of Sugriva's army
